name: Birds
description: Songbirds, waterbirds, cranes and parrots from Japanese bird-and-flower prints and European natural-history drawings, made for a tall screen that stays bright all day.

works.alt_text: An orange and blue parrot perches on a branch of white plum blossom beside a column of handwritten poetry.
A green lovebird with a rosy face sits on a leafy branch, with hills and woods below a grey-blue sky.
Three white cranes and two young birds among blue irises at the edge of a pond, with a large red sun rising behind golden clouds.
Two brown sparrows fly between stalks of bamboo as snow falls.
A small yellow bush warbler perches among pink roses on a pale green ground.
A grey waxwing with a crest and red-tipped wings sits on a slender branch against a blue sky and distant hills.
Two swallows swoop above a kingfisher perched on a branch of pink hibiscus with dark green leaves.
Two white egrets stand in snow at the edge of a green stream under a soft pink sky.
A dark green pheasant with a long golden tail pecks at the grass beneath a white-flowering cherry tree on green hills, with a poem above.
Two mallard ducks fly low over reeds beneath a pale full moon in a blue-grey night sky.
A cuckoo flies down past soft clouds toward a bank of pink and white azaleas.
A pair of mandarin ducks rest among broad grey ink lotus leaves, with a line of calligraphy at the top left.
A sheet of colourful flower sprays in pink, yellow and blue, with a small blue bird among them.
A grey speckled hawk perches calmly on a gnarled branch of white plum blossom.
A tall brown heron with a long beak and speckled neck stands in profile on cream paper.
A small grey bird with a dark cap sits on a camellia branch with pink and red flowers and a short poem.
Small sparrows flutter over a pale bush of chrysanthemums while two round puppies play below, in soft ink and colour.
A cuckoo flies above white clouds over sprays of small white deutzia flowers, with lines of poetry beside it.
Two blue-and-grey Florida scrub jays among leafy branches hung with small yellow fruit, on a wide cream sheet.
A white crane flies above a tangle of ink plum branches on pale paper, with calligraphy to the right.
Pink and white flowers on a cream sheet with a yellow bird and a red bird standing among them.
Two white herons stand close together at the edge of dark water, drawn in soft grey.
Ducks swim and dive among tall reeds and lily pads on a quiet pond, in a fine black and white etching.
A cock pheasant stands upright in heather and long grass while a hen pheasant pecks at the ground beside it.
